Make a Run's Output Dir a Shared-Backed Symlink (Best-Effort, Portable)

Source: R/prepare_scan_run.R
ensure_shared_output_dir.Rd

The integration point for born-shared outputs: a portable, guarded hook that turns a run's output_dir into a symlink into lab-shared storage before the run populates it, so the bytes live off /home and the leaf is registered for clone reconstruction. prepare_scan_run() calls it for SNV-set runs; the GLOWanalyses upstream templates call it directly when a run opts in (config field symlinked_shared_root non-NULL). This function does not read config — the caller decides whether to call it and passes the resolved share_root.

ensure_shared_output_dir(output_dir, share_root = NULL, verbose = 0)

Arguments

output_dir

Character. The run output directory (relative or absolute).

share_root

Character or NULL. Explicit shared root to symlink into; NULL uses the shared-storage tooling's default root.

verbose

Integer. >= 1 prints a one-line note when a symlink is made.

Value

Logical, invisibly: TRUE iff a shared-backed symlink was created.

Details

If output_dir does not yet exist and lies inside a git repository that ships tools/shared-storage/scaffold_shared_output.sh, it invokes that helper to create output_dir as a symlink into shared storage and register it in the manifest. With share_root = NULL the shared location is the helper's default (tools/shared-storage/shared-root.conf, overridable by GLOW_SHARE_ROOT); with an explicit share_root the symlink points into <share_root>/<repo-relative-leaf> and that exact target is recorded in the manifest (so a clone reconstructs it regardless of any default).

It is a deliberate no-op (returning FALSE, after which the caller's own dir.create makes a plain local dir) when: the dir already exists (real or symlink); the parent does not exist yet; the path is not inside a git repo (e.g. a tempfile() under /tmp, so unit tests are unaffected); the path is outside the enclosing repo; the leaf is empty (the repo root); the helper is absent; or the helper fails (e.g. the shared volume is unavailable). No shared path is hardcoded here, so the package stays portable.

See also

prepare_scan_run

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Opt-in born-sharing from a workflow template: symlink this run's outputs/ into a
# shared root before creating it (no-op outside a repo that ships the tooling).
ensure_shared_output_dir("runs/myrun/outputs", share_root = "/project/lab/shared")
} # }
